import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Use a pointplot to show survival probability by Pclass and Sex
# 'survived' is 0 or 1, so the mean represents the survival probability
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    kind='point',
    capsize=0.1,  # Add caps to error bars
    palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'lightcoral'}, # Custom palette for clarity
    height=6,
    aspect=1.2
)

# Set title and labels
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Probability")
g.set_xticklabels(["First Class", "Second Class", "Third Class"])
g.set_yticklabels([f'{y:.0%}' for y in g.ax.get_yticks()]) # Format y-axis as percentage
g.fig.suptitle('Survival Probability on the Titanic by Passenger Class and Sex', y=1.03, fontsize=16) # Adjust y for suptitle

# Improve legend title
g._legend.set_title("Sex")

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
